title: E-commerce — storefront inventory triage
niche: storefront inventory check behind a demo login
task: Go to https://www.saucedemo.com and sign in with the demo credentials the site publishes on its own login page: username standard_user, password secret_sauce. With the product catalogue open, sort it by price from lowest to highest. Then report the total number of products listed, the name and price of the cheapest product, the name and price of the most expensive product, and the sum of all product prices in USD.

portal.label: Sort by
portal.hint: Signed in as standard_user. Sort the catalogue to rank every product by price.
portal.answer: 6 products; cheapest Onesie USD 7.99, dearest Fleece Jacket USD 49.99; sum USD 129.94
